optimizedContext.value:
# Kernel

## Rules
- `Kernel` groups concrete use-case instances under `changes`, `specs`, `project`; callers use `kernel.<group>.<useCase>.execute(...)`. Every exported application use case except `_shared/` and ConfigWriter operations requires entry + wiring.
- `createKernel(config, options?)` returns immutable plain object. Shared `CompositionResolver` supplies one `ChangeRepository`, per-workspace `SpecRepository`, `SchemaRegistry`, lazy caching `SchemaProvider` via `ResolveSchema`, `HookRunner`, `RunStepHooks`, `ContentHasher`, merged `ArtifactParserRegistry`; failed schema resolutions not cached.
- Use cases never call `SchemaRegistry.resolve()`; use `SchemaProvider.get()`. Hooks derive from schema/`schemaOverrides`, never `config.workflow`.
- VCS/actor use `createVcsAdapter`/`createVcsActorResolver`. `KernelOptions.extraNodeModulesPaths` appends schema search roots. Built-in + external registries merge additively; conflicts/unknown refs fail. Graph store remains outside core.
- `FsChangeRepository.get()` auto-invalidates artifact drift after `designing` or with active approval; cause `artifact-drift`; normalize legacy `artifact-change`.
- Expose `changes.repo`, `specs.repos`. `kernel.specs` excludes `saveMetadata`/`invalidateMetadata`; `PersistSpecMetadata` remains internal to `MaterializeSpecMetadata`.
- Change group includes lifecycle, approvals, tracking/review, verification, artifact validation/preview/context, overlap, archive, draft/discard, hooks, repository operations. Specs group includes listing/search/get/outline/schema validation/resolution, health, metadata materialization, persisted schema/deps/implementation/optimizations, context. Project group includes workspaces, summary/context resolution, readonly config, project metadata.
- Plugin declarations come from `kernel.project.getConfig.execute()` or loaded `SpecdConfig`; no kernel `listPlugins`. Config writes use `createConfigWriter()`; no `initProject|addPlugin|removePlugin` kernel paths. Obsolete skills-manifest use cases excluded and unexported.
- Execute inputs never re-pass construction-time config. Runtime overrides allowed only for documented per-call controls on `CompileContext`, `GetProjectContext`, `GetSpecContext`, `TransitionChange`, `ArchiveChange`, `RunStepHooks`, `GetStatus`, `CreateChange`, `ValidateArtifacts`.

## Constraints
- Kernel mandatory public domain-use-case facade; config mutation separate via `createConfigWriter()`.
- Adding exported domain use case without Kernel entry is violation; removal is breaking.
- Kernel contains wiring/grouping only, no business logic.
- `Kernel` and `createKernel` public; `createKernelInternals` private.
